title: Constructing a Collagen Hydrogel for the Delivery of Stem Cell-loaded Chitosan Microspheres
protocol: Isolate rat perirenal and epididymal adipose tissue.
Wash the isolated adipose tissue with sterile Hank's buffered salt solution containing 1% fetal bovine serum.
Mince the washed adipose tissue into small pieces.
Transfer 1-2 g of minced tissue to a 50 mL tube containing 25 mL of HBSS with 1% FBS.
Centrifuge the mixture at 500 g for 8 min at room temperature.
Collect and transfer the free-floating adipose tissue layer to a 125 mL erlenmeyer flask.
Treat the collected tissue with 25 mL of collagenase type II (200 U/mL) in HBSS for 45 min at 37 °C on an orbital shaker set at 125 rpm.
Remove and discard the liquid fraction below the oil and adipose layer.
Filter the remaining material sequentially through a 100-μm nylon mesh filter, followed by a 70-μm nylon mesh filter.
Centrifuge the filtrate at 500 g for 10 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant from the centrifuged sample and discard.
Wash the cell pellet twice with 25 mL of HBSS.
Resuspend the washed cells in 50 mL of growth medium supplemented with MesenPRO RS Growth Supplement, antibiotic-antimycotic, and L-glutamine.
Pipette the resuspended cells into two T75 flasks (25 mL per flask).
Culture the adipose-derived stem cells (ASC) in a 5% CO2 humidified incubator at 37 °C.

Emulsify an aqueous solution of chitosan (6 mL of 3%w/v chitosan in 0.5 M acetic acid) in a 100 mL oil phase mixture consisting of soya oil, n-octanol (1:2 v/v) and 5% sorbitan-mono-oleate using overhead stirring at 1700 rpm.
Stir the mixture with magnetic stirring at 1000 rpm simultaneously in opposite directions for approximately 1 hour until a stable water-in-oil emulsion is obtained.
Add 1.5 mL of 1% w/v potassium hydroxide in n-octanol every 15 min for 4 h (24 mL total) to initiate ionic crosslinking.
After completion of the crosslinking reaction, decant the oil phase containing CSM and immediately add spheres to 100 mL of acetone.
Wash spheres with acetone until no residual oil is present.
Dry recovered spheres in a vacuum desiccator and analyze without further processing.
Wash CSM three times with sterile water to remove residual salts.
Sterilize CSM with absolute alcohol.
Incubate 5 mg of microspheres with 1 mL of 0.5% TNBS solution in a 50 mL glass tube for 4 h at 40 °C.
Hydrolyze the mixture with the addition of 3 mL of 6N HCl at 60 °C for 2h.
Cool the samples to room temperature.
Extract free TNBS by adding 5 mL of deionized water and 10 mL of ethyl ether.
Warm a 5 mL aliquot of the aqueous phase to 40 °C in a water bath for 15 min to evaporate any residual ether, cool to room temperature.
Dilute with 15 mL of water.
Measure absorbance at 345 nm using TNBS solution without chitosan as blank and the chitosan used for CSM preparation.
Estimate the number of free amino groups in CSM relative to chitosan.
Equilibrate 5 mg of sterilized CSM from section 2.5 in sterile HBSS overnight.
Add equilibrated CSM to an 8-μm pore size membrane culture plate insert (24-well plate).
Aspirate HBSS from the membrane.
Add 300 μL of growth medium inside the insert.
Add 700 μL of growth medium outside the insert.
Resuspend ASC at an appropriate concentration in 200 μL of growth medium.
Seed ASC over the CSM inside the culture plate insert.
Incubate ASC seeded on CSM for 24 h in a 5% CO2 humidified incubator at 37 °C.
Collect ASC-loaded CSM in a sterile 1.5-ml microcentrifuge tube without disturbing cells that have migrated into the insert membrane.
Add 250 μL of fresh growth medium to the tube.
Add 25 μL MTT solution (5 mg/mL) to each tube.
Incubate for 4 h in a 5% CO2 humidified incubator at 37 °C.
Remove the medium after incubation.
Add 250 μL of dimethyl sulfoxide to the mixture.
Vortex the mixture for 2-5 min to solubilize the formazan complex.
Centrifuge CSM at 2700 x g for 5 min.
Determine the supernatant absorbance measured at 570 nm using 630 nm as reference.
Mix ASC-loaded CSM (5 mg containing ≈ 2 x 10^4 cells) with type 1 collagen (7.5 mg/mL).
Adjust the pH of the mixture to 6.8 using 2 N NaOH.
Add the fibrillated collagen-ASC-CSM mixture to a 12-well plate.
Incubate for 30 min at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 humidified incubator.
Incubate the collagen-ASC-CSM gels for up to 14 days at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 humidified incubator.
